name: The Suggestion
flavor: You do not tell them what to do. You tell them what they were already about to do, and they are far too polite to argue.
description: You hand one creature that can hear and understand you a course of action it believes was its own idea. Choose one option below as you cast. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; on a failure it must obey. It is never made to harm itself or its allies, and the compulsion ends the moment it takes damage from you or your companions.

options.name: Take a walk
options.effect: On its next turn it must use its action to Dash, moving as directly away from you as its path allows. It provokes opportunity attacks as normal for leaving anyone's reach.

options.name: Put that down
options.effect: It immediately drops whatever it is holding in one hand of your choosing, and it cannot pick anything back up until the end of its next turn.

narration: You say it plainly, as though confirming something already agreed, and they nod along with a decision they never made.
sheetSummary: Action, 60 ft, cooldown 2. Target must hear and understand you. Choose an option as you cast; Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or it must obey on its next turn. Never made to harm itself or its allies; ends if you or your allies damage it.
